status: Controller-frozen AUTH-USER-SESSION v0.2 protocol semantics, validated by User and Gateway; other domain integration pending.
flow: verifyToken(token) performs CPU-only signature and claim verification
load session JSON by verified sid using authoritative asynchronous read
SessionCodec.decode(json) rejects malformed state with status 503
validateSession(verified, optionalSession, requiredScope) checks current expiry and binding then route scope
external_token_header: exactly one token header; reject duplicates or comma-merged values
identity_headers: reject X-Internal-*, X-User-*, X-Principal-*, X-Service-*, X-Identity-*, X-Authenticated-*, X-Forwarded-User, X-Remote-User, X-Auth-Request-User
client_notes: Never trust forwarded identity; validate directly. No positive session cache. Private keys and blocking Redis clients are excluded. Redis GET must use a non-pipelined, non-transactional client so null means missing, not an incomplete operation.

java_api.verify: VerifiedToken verifyToken(String rawToken) throws AuthFailure(401); VerifiedToken exposes userId(), sid(), scope(), expiresAt()
java_api.decode: Session SessionCodec.decode(String json) throws AuthFailure(503) for malformed or incompatible representation
java_api.authorize: Principal validateSession(VerifiedToken token, Optional<Session> state, String requiredScope) throws AuthFailure(401/403); requiredScope is blog or admin
java_api.async: Use verified.sid() to asynchronously GET the authority. A missing key becomes Optional.empty(); Redis errors/timeouts become 503. Decode non-null JSON and then call validateSession. Recheck validity at validation time.
